title: Legislative Building Field Trip Pilot Program
lastAction: Ref to the Com on Appropriations, if favorable, Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill creates a two-year pilot program that provides grants to North Carolina public schools to fund field trips to the Legislative Building, with up to $2,000 per school available for transportation costs. The program prioritizes funding for schools in economically disadvantaged counties and requires the Department of Public Instruction to manage applications and report on participation.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this program increases civic engagement by giving students firsthand experience with how state government works, which can strengthen democratic participation and understanding. The program particularly benefits schools in economically disadvantaged tier 1 counties that may lack funding for such educational field trips, promoting equity in educational opportunities across the state.
aiConArguments: Opponents may question whether $1.5 million annually is the most effective use of education funds, noting that only a limited number of schools can participate and the program is temporary. Some may argue that virtual tours or classroom instruction could achieve similar civics education goals at lower cost, or that the funds could address more pressing classroom needs.
